title: The conformally invariant embedding of a planar lattice
statement: Given a lattice $L$, considered as a combinatorial object without an embedding into the plane, which periodic embedding of $L$ corresponds to a conformally invariant scaling limit of critical site-percolation? Equivalently, for a planar lattice $L$ and $\b1\in\mathbb{H}$, determine the value $\b1_p$ (if it exists) for which critical percolation is isotropic in the scaling limit.

title: Pairwise-generating sets in maximal 2-generated direct powers of finite simple groups

The report states that a minimizer exists for $N\leq MZ$, but that it is not known whether there is a maximum such $N$.
